shared_elements: procession/row of figures moving in one direction
low-relief narrative frieze on a horizontal band
registers bounded by a border strip
justification: Both are horizontal low-relief friezes with a file of profile human figures striding in the same direction, rendered with similar squat proportions, patterned fringed robes and hatched detailing, each carrying something in the hands, and both include a profile animal within the same register. The biggest differences in content are the subject: A shows an assault on a walled, towered city with archers, siege apparatus and a winged emblem above, while B shows a peaceful tribute/lead-animal procession with a two-humped camel and rosette-chain borders, motifs entirely absent from the other.
